---
title: "Overall survival censoring scenarios — fitting"
subtitle: "One unadjusted Bayesian PH model per scenario"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Each scenario is fitted once with randomized treatment as the only predictor.
The M-spline baseline hazard and priors match the previous unadjusted analysis.
No imputation is required. Day-zero deaths enter the likelihood at 0.5 days,
within their recorded week; observations censored at day zero are excluded
from the likelihood because they contribute no follow-up.

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-os-censoring-scenarios
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rstanarm)

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
artifact_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-censoring-scenarios"
)
prepared_path <- file.path(artifact_dir, "scenarios.parquet")
prepared <- arrow::read_parquet(prepared_path)
model_dir <- file.path(artifact_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

scenarios <- c("best-case", "worst-case")
for (index in seq_along(scenarios)) {
  scenario_name <- scenarios[[index]]
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(scenario_name, "-model.rds"))
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path) &&
      file.mtime(model_path) >= file.mtime(prepared_path)) next

  fitting_data <- prepared |>
    dplyr::filter(scenario == scenario_name, fitting_time_days > 0)
  model <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
    formula = survival::Surv(fitting_time_days, event_death) ~ tx,
    data = fitting_data,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    prior = rstanarm::normal(0, 0.55),
    prior_intercept = rstanarm::normal(0, 20),
    prior_aux = rstanarm::dirichlet(1),
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    warmup = 1000L,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 1300L)
  )
  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
